mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dcs_file_review_config (config_id, tenant_id, enabled, categories, guard_mode, guard_whitelist, guard_deep_scan_max_mb, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{configId}, #{tenantId}, #{enabled}, #{categories}, #{guardMode}, #{guardWhitelist}, #{guardDeepScanMaxMb}, #{operatorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{operatorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, categories = EXCLUDED.categories, guard_mode = EXCLUDED.guard_mode, guard_whitelist = EXCLUDED.guard_whitelist, guard_deep_scan_max_mb = EXCLUDED.guard_deep_scan_max_mb, update_by = EXCLUDED.update_by, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
